name: Processing Characteristics 10
definition: Processing characteristics linked to a redemption from an investment fund or alternative/hedge fund.

DealingCurrencyAccepted.name: Dealing Currency Accepted
DealingCurrencyAccepted.definition: Currency in which a redemption is accepted.

RedemptionAuthorisation.name: Redemption Authorisation
RedemptionAuthorisation.definition: Specifies whether an application form is required for a redemption.

AmountIndicator.name: Amount Indicator
AmountIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a redemption can be instructed by amount.

UnitsIndicator.name: Units Indicator
UnitsIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a redemption can be instructed as a number of units.

Rounding.name: Rounding
Rounding.definition: Indicates the rounding direction applied to nearest unit.

PercentageIndicator.name: Percentage Indicator
PercentageIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a redemption can be instructed as a percentage of holding.

MainFundOrderDeskLocation.name: Main Fund Order Desk Location
MainFundOrderDeskLocation.definition: Location of the main fund order desk.

DealingFrequency.name: Dealing Frequency
DealingFrequency.definition: Frequency at which the redemptions are done.

DealingFrequencyDescription.name: Dealing Frequency Description
DealingFrequencyDescription.definition: Description of frequency at which the redemption is done.

DealingCutOffTime.name: Dealing Cut Off Time
DealingCutOffTime.definition: Latest time at which an order to redeem can be given.

DealConfirmationTime.name: Deal Confirmation Time
DealConfirmationTime.definition: Time at which the deal confirmation is issued.

DealConfirmationTimeFrame.name: Deal Confirmation Time Frame
DealConfirmationTimeFrame.definition: Time frame within which the deal confirmation is issued.

LimitedPeriod.name: Limited Period
LimitedPeriod.definition: Specific period, for example, for some guaranteed funds, during which the units/shares may be redeemed.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the redemption processing characteristics.

DealingCutOffTimeFrameRule.definition: If DealingCutOffTimeFrame is present, then DealingCutOffTimeFrame/OtherTimeFrameDescription or DealingCutOffTimeFrame/ReferToOrderDesk or DealingCutOffTimeFrame/TradeMinus must be present.
